_comment: Names registered by the NATIVE layer (Mewjector + mewframework) that are not present in base game data. The validator treats these as valid status/ability/component references so data mods that pair with a native mod validate. Seeded with JokersLuck so mods/jokers-luck validates. Add a native mod's registered names here (plain strings, or {"name","kind","mod"} objects). Kind "model" is a 3D model a native mod registers with the mesh engine: it only resolves a GON graphics.model "@Name" reference (docs/data-mods.md "3D models in a mod (preview)"), never a status/ability/character.
